en.io: Input: current repository, branch, diff, and project commands. Output: concise pass/fail gate report, branch ahead/behind state, and either a normal git push or a held local state after user choice.
en.boundary: Push is always gated by explicit confirmation. It never bypasses hooks or force-pushes main/master. A basic sweep is not a comprehensive security audit, and missing or externally failing project gates can block release.
dependencies: Project lint, typecheck, build, and test commands
scenarios: Push approved commits after reviewing branch state.

zh.io: 输入：当前仓库、分支、差异和项目命令。输出：简洁的门禁通过/失败报告、分支领先/落后状态，以及用户选择后的普通 git push 或保留本地状态。
zh.boundary: 推送始终需要明确确认；不会绕过钩子，也不会强推 main/master。基础扫描不是全面安全审计，缺失或受外部改动影响的门禁可能阻止发布。
dependencies: Git 仓库和已配置远端
项目 lint、类型检查、构建和测试命令
scenarios: 在确认分支状态后推送已批准提交。
